headline: Base Action Intensifies Across Divided Fronts
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the heaviest movement shifting toward Weathered Expanse, where 65 strategic-base events were recorded in 24 hours, including six in the latest two and twelve in six hours; its holdings remain divided at five Warden and four Colonial. Stonecradle also quickened, reaching 14 daily events, eight in six hours and three in the latest two, with four Warden, four Colonial and one neutral base. Linn Mercy reports 15 daily events, three in the latest two, and remains split eight Colonial to three Warden. Farranac Coast has six daily events, all six in the latest two hours, against a nine-to-two Colonial lead. By contrast, Stlican Shelf has gone quiet in the latest two hours after 53 daily events and eleven in six, while Callahan’s Passage records no fresh movement in either window despite 15 events across the day. Deadlands likewise shows no recent base action after fourteen daily events. Casualty and enlistment rates are rising sharply on several active fronts, but ownership change remains concentrated in the event-bearing regions.
